title: The 999-666-333 bounce, missing-one carry and xi contraction test

verdict.conclusion: the exact 999 quotient is a D3 three-cycle, while the actual 1000 carry lifts it to a 1000-state dihedral permutation with T^3 equal to a one-step backward drift; neither is contractive. The affine factor-one-third contraction is a separate interpolation that leaves the named stations after one bounce and whose zero-set invariance would already be equivalent to RH

quotient999Model.reflection: R(n)=999-n; on the quotient it fixes the seam and exchanges 333 with 666
quotient999Model.status: exact periodic reflection/rotation model; no contraction

carryAware1000Model.reverseCarryIdentity: for T_-(n)=n-333, T_-^3(n)=n+1 mod 1000; this is the 999->666->333 direction
carryAware1000Model.spectralConsequence: the bounce operators are finite permutations with root-of-unity eigenvalues of modulus one, so they preserve rather than contract channel norm

missingOne.role: a one-step drift/cocycle after every three translations, not a contraction
missingOne.arithmeticEffect: the apparent order-three orbit modulo 999 becomes one orbit through all 1000 states when the carry is retained

affineContractionCandidate.combinedBounce: B(n)=R(C(n))=666-n/3; in centered normalized coordinates eta -> -eta/3
affineContractionCandidate.status: mathematically valid strict contraction, but not generated by the exact periodic bounce rule

completedXiDiagnostics.method: standard-library Euler-Maclaurin zeta and Lanczos gamma evaluation
completedXiDiagnostics.interpretation: the cyclic translations are not symmetries of the xi zero spectrum, and the horizontal contraction is not a functional identity of xi. It fixes known critical-line zeros, so requiring it to preserve the complete zero set is an RH-equivalent new hypothesis rather than an independently observed symmetry

bounceContractionLemma.map: B_a(eta+i gamma)=-a eta+i gamma for any fixed 0<a<1
bounceContractionLemma.statement: if every non-trivial xi zero is mapped to another xi zero by B_a, then all eta vanish: otherwise the iterates are distinct zeros converging to the finite point i gamma, contradicting isolation of zeros of a nonzero entire function
bounceContractionLemma.converse: under RH every zero has eta=0 and is fixed by B_a
bounceContractionLemma.status: zero-set invariance under any strict horizontal contraction is equivalent to RH

primeSideAssessment.translationFailure: shifting the real part rescales each Euler factor by a prime-dependent p^(-c), so it is not induced by M=mu* or its inverse Z
primeSideAssessment.supportFailure: the finite decimal orbit has root-of-unity frequencies, not the log(p^k) event support of the completed explicit formula
primeSideAssessment.requiredTheorem: derive from the completed von Mangoldt ledger, without assuming RH, that its zero image is invariant under one strict horizontal contraction; this would immediately prove RH by the bounce-contraction lemma
